image: So the ruler issues the charge,
proclaiming it to the four quarters.
lines: It is tied to a metal brake.
But if you set out, you meet misfortune.
A lean pig, surely, stamps and stamps.
There is a fish in the wrapping.
but it is not good for guests.
There is no skin on his buttocks,
There is no fish in the wrapping.
A melon is wrapped in willow leaves,
He meets it with his horns.

notes.name_en: 姤 is an unexpected meeting/encounter; plain 'Meeting', not Wilhelm's 'Coming to Meet'.
notes.L1: 金柅 a metal cart-brake; the lean pig (羸豕) stamping (蹢躅) is the small force barely held.
notes.L4: 44 L3 repeats 43 L4 in the Chinese (臀無膚其行次且); the English repeats word for word.
